v1.0.1.description:
After some playtesting, a few issues have appeared and changes have been made, both bugfixes and gameplay changes

- The Arcade Machine in each Salvage area gives Money for playing them, configurable via YAML option (set to $0.10 per token, same as during nights)
- Upgrade Cadet now starts selling only ~1/4th of every purchaseable upgrade, adding another ~1/4th per Salvage area, selling his full inventory from Salvage 4 onwards. This is to prevent giving the player too many Sphere 1 locations which are not all possible/easy early on without major grinding

- Fixed animatronics that were already salvaged appearing through Backdoor Trading when Randomise Animatronics was on
- Fixed animatronics that were not salvaged would sometimes not appear through Backdoor Trading when Randomise Animatronics was on
- Fixed being unable to give a Gift Box to the Puppets if you had received a Scrap animatronic via a non-Scrap animatronic if you did not have the necessary story-flag when Randomise Animatronics was on
- Fixed salvaging Scrap animatronics not sending their associated check while Randomise Animatronics was on
v1.0.1.title: Frickbears 3 AP v1.0.1
